mechanics.cell_grid: world is 11 cols x H rows of 6x6px cells; camera x=0 fixed, scrolls vertically; player world col = avatar_screen_x//6
mechanics.camera: player renders at screen rows 36-41 while gravity is up, rows 26-31 while gravity is down
mechanics.click_mapping: screen (x,y) -> cell (x//6, (y + camera_y)//6); camera_y = py*6-36 (grav up) or py*6-26 (grav down); click cell (cx,cy): x=cx*6+3, y=(cy-py)*6+39 (up) / +29 (down)
mechanics.balloon: after every lateral move into a passable cell the balloon rises (or falls, if gravity flipped) until blocked; passable = empty, toggle-open '2', flood row 'm'

cells.g: gravity button: click (anywhere on screen) toggles global rise/fall, single use, player immediately rises/falls
cells.y: spread: click removes it and spawns blockers in its 4 empty neighbours
cells.m/w: flood surface/body (levels 1-3): rises 1 cell per 2 flood-ticking actions

mechanics.click_above_quirk: clicking the cell directly above (grav up) / below (grav down) the player launches the player through that cell; the traverse path is computed BEFORE the clicked cell's new state, so even flipping '2'->'1' above you still launches you through it
mechanics.flood: parity counter increments on EVERY move and click; the flood advances only on lateral moves that end with zero rise (incl. bumps) when the post-increment parity is even; death when player row == flood row at that check; clicks and rising moves never advance the flood
mechanics.action_budget: row 63 fills one pixel per action; at 64 actions (levels 1-6) the level is lost mid-run [measured: death on the 64th level-2 action]; source shows 128 for levels 7-9, 192 for level 10
mechanics.game_over: GAME_OVER freezes everything; only RESET (0) recovers, restarting the current level with a fresh budget
mechanics.no_first_action_swallow: measured: first action after init and after each level transition takes full effect

remaining_levels: 5-10 unattempted (timebox); all maps transcribed in grids.txt, semantics in solver.py header + this file
